description: Source file implementing the PlayerInfo plugin class, handling initialization, deinitialization, processing web requests, and JSON-RPC methods for retrieving audio and video codecs information.

classes.name: PlayerInfo
classes.description: Main plugin class managing player information, codecs, and JSON-RPC methods.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the PlayerInfo plugin, sets up codecs, registers JSON-RPC methods, and manages Dolby output interface.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters methods, releases interfaces, and releases the player object.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns static info about the plugin; currently empty.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests; currently does nothing.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests, supports GET to return codecs info in JSON format.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Populates codecs data (audio and video) into the provided JSON structure.

methods.name: get_audiocodecs
methods.description: Custom JSON-RPC method to retrieve audio codecs as a JSON array.

methods.name: get_videocodecs
methods.description: Custom JSON-RPC method to retrieve video codecs as a JSON array.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Handles remote connection deactivation, triggers plugin deactivation.
